_doc: MCP servers yang di-consume BIMA_CORE. `enabled: false` di-skip saat boot. Variabel ${VAR} di-expand dari os.environ + BIMA_ROOT alias.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: HTTP fetcher official Anthropic — extract isi URL ke text/markdown.

servers.name: markitdown
servers.description: Microsoft Markitdown — convert PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX ke markdown.

servers.name: sequential_thinking
servers.description: Anthropic Sequential Thinking — structured reasoning chain.

servers.name: memory_anthropic
servers.description: Anthropic Memory MCP — persistent KV memory cross-session.

servers.name: time
servers.description: Official Anthropic Time MCP — current time, timezone conversion, business hours.

servers.name: duckduckgo
servers.description: DuckDuckGo web search — DISABLED. Redundant dengan SerperDevTool + Tavily fallback di t5_intel. Aktifkan kalau Serper habis kuota dan butuh fallback gratis.

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Microsoft Playwright MCP — DISABLED. Redundant dengan BrowserUseTool (tools/browser_use_tool.py) di t5_intel. 23 tool ke 3 agent bikin noise.
servers._note: Kalau diaktifkan: scope attach_to ke ['visual','seniman'] aja, jangan 'intel' (konflik BrowserUseTool). Chromium udah ke-download di ~/.cache/ms-playwright/.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Official Anthropic Git MCP — log/blame/diff/show untuk repo BIMA_CORE. Read-history focus.
servers._note: Mekanik di-skip karena udah punya GitAutomationTool (status/commit/push) di t8_mekanik.py. Git MCP cuma buat kodok diagnostic history.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Upstash Context7 — resolve-library-id + get-library-docs, fetch dokumentasi library eksternal versi terbaru (anti-halusinasi API outdated). Jalan tanpa API key (rate limit lebih rendah); kalau mau naikin limit, tambah CONTEXT7_API_KEY manual ke blok env di sini + .env (skema `_expand_vars` di mcp_client_manager.py gak fallback ke kosong kalau var gak di-set, jadi jangan pakai `${VAR}` di sini sebelum key-nya beneran ada di .env).

servers.name: sqlite
servers.description: SQLite MCP reference — DISABLED karena upstream archived tanpa security update. Pakai akses SQLite internal yang dibatasi.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Filesystem MCP — DISABLED. Mekanik udah punya FileSaverTool+FileReadTool. Visual/seniman image-gen tool save internal. 14 tool ke 4 agent = noise.
servers._note: Scope udah dibatasi ke outputs/. Kalau diaktifkan: hapus 'mekanik' dari attach_to (konflik FileSaverTool).

servers.name: github
servers.description: GitHub MCP — issues, PRs, code search. ⚠ BUTUH GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN di .env.

servers.name: searxng
servers.description: SearXNG MCP — privacy-respecting metasearch. ⚠ BUTUH SEARXNG_URL di .env (instance public atau self-host).
